findings.defect: Two divergences from IL-illinois.json on the objection window. treatments.family: MI guidance packet - automatic set-aside, 93-day-or-more misdemeanors

findings.defect: States the One Bad Night rule without its two limiting conditions: 'Michigan also collapses convictions arising from the same incident under MCL 780.621b, which can change the count'. MI-michigan.json: 'multiple felonies or multiple misdemeanors are treated as a SINGLE conviction for set-aside purposes if they occurred within 24 hours and arose from the same transaction - UNLESS one is assaultive, weapon-involved, or punishable by >10 years, which break the grouping.' The 24-hour window and the three grouping-breakers are both dropped, so a participant may conclude same-incident convictions always count as one. The lane's own commit message says the counting rules are 'carried precisely'; on this rule they are not.
